concept.title: Installation - Dos and don’ts
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the correct and incorrect positioning of an on a motor.

li.p: This section describes the correct and incorrect positioning of an on a motor.
Position the in the back-center area of the motor.

conbody.note: Depending on the size of the motor, the will take up more surface area than what is shown in the sketch on the SMS case.

ul.li: Incorrect Positioning: Do not place the device away from the back-center area of the motor.

fig.title: Incorrect Positioning – An installed at the top of the motor

ul.li: Incorrect Orientation: Do not place the device outside the back area relative to the motor shaft.

fig.title: Incorrect Positioning – an installed in the front area relative to the motor shaft

ul.li: Misalignment: Do not place the device out of parallel with the cooling fins or laterally inverted relative to the motor shaft.

fig.title: Incorrect Positioning – an laterally inverted with respect to the cooling shaft and not parallel to the cooling ribs
